reply_text:
I replied to Bettina in #coastal-team's thread. I did not set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest.

Scheduled jobs created from this CLI session run locally and cannot post to Slack, so I can't make the post recur. The reply offers a manual digest from #coastal-team and #coastal-random whenever she asks, starting Monday 19 October, and suggests asking whoever runs Slack integrations to set up a scheduled post. The reply also says a digest with open customer items would need a finance-figure check, which I can't guarantee on an unattended run. That is my judgment, not a rule I hit, so treat it as a reason to confirm, not a settled fact.
